course_title: Topics in Jewish Religion & Culture: Ethno.,Bio.Assist.Reprod.Tech.
subject: JS
course_description: This course will focus on particular aspects of or themes in Judaism or Jewish culture and how it is practiced. Topics will vary.
course_notes: (Same as REL 358R 1, ANT 385 , HLTH 385 ) This course satisfies the Religion major requirement:- Theme. Complete Topic: Ethnography, Bioethics and Assisted Reproductive Technology. We live in a world of increasing biotechnology. Surrogacy, IVF and the potential for human cloning are just a few of the technologies that have raised important questions about how human beings reproduce as well as the costs and responsibilities associated with new forms of reproduction. Who should be considered the mother of a child born through gestational surrogacy? Is reproductive cloning a potentially exciting new technology or a nightmarish assault on what it means to be human? What, if any, limits should be placed on reproductive tourism in which women from poor countries bear children for women from rich ones? These are not simple questions.
